description_en: Queries the execution status of scripts in EdgeScript (ES)
description_zh: 调用DescribeEsExecuteData查询ES规则的运行情况
name: DescribeEsExecuteData

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据的起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间表示，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间表示，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the rule. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/90924.html operation to query script IDs
parameters.help_zh: 规则ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/90924.html接口获取规则ID
parameters.name: rule_id

Columns.description_en: The time and column names in the table that shows the status of the script
Columns.description_zh: ES规则运行情况图表的时间和列名的列表

items.description_en: The time and column names in the table that shows the status of the script
items.description_zh: ES规则运行情况图表的时间和列名

Name.description_en: The name of the table that shows the status of the script
Name.description_zh: ES规则运行情况图表的表名

Points.description_en: The list of timestamps and values in the corresponding columns of the table that shows the status of the script
Points.description_zh: 图表对应列的时间和数值的列表

items.description_en: The timestamp and value of the corresponding columns in the table that shows the status of the script
items.description_zh: 图表对应列的时间和数值
